notes.title: Launch Check v1 build
notes.body: Claude Code plugin that scans an app before launch and helps fix it. From docs/07-milestones.md.

notes.title: Empty score is null, verdict "No checks yet"
notes.body: When no applicable checks ran, score is null instead of 0 or 100; runs also store verdict and counts.notImplemented.
notes.considered: 0: reads as a failing app. 100: reads as ready.

notes.title: Repo root is the plugin root
notes.body: plugin.json, skills/, engine/, catalog/ at the root; docs/ and fixtures/ are dev-only.
notes.considered: A launch-check/ subfolder: catalog would need copying or a ../ path.

notes.title: Slash commands are built as skills, no commands/ folder
notes.body: Current Claude Code docs mark commands/ as deprecated.

notes.title: Spell checking uses Hunspell (WASM) with Hspell's Hebrew dictionary
notes.body: hunspell-asm loads Hebrew in 0.3s; flags a word only if unknown, used once, and one edit from a known word.
notes.considered: nspell: over 2 minutes to load Hebrew. A plain word list: Hebrew prefixes make it useless.

notes.title: Severity counts are per check, not per finding
notes.body: A check failing on 3 pages is one blocker, matching passed/skipped which were already per check. Also added top-level checks map and runs[].changes to state.

notes.title: Local scans always start their own copy on a free port
notes.body: Never reuse a server already on the usual port: in M1 another project's server sat on the port and the scan read the wrong app.
notes.considered: Reuse a running server (docs/02): risks scanning a different app.

notes.title: Form checks need consent and a local or staging target
notes.body: Flag: --consent submit-forms. Skipped checks record needs: submit-forms so the skill knows what to ask. Writes are answered by Launch Check itself where possible.

notes.title: A rotated key in git history is closed as accepted risk
notes.body: Launch Check can't verify rotation from outside; the user confirms and the finding is accepted with reason key rotated.

notes.title: Consent to side effects lasts 12 hours
notes.body: A yes to test submissions carries over to rechecks in the same working session; a scan next week asks again.

notes.title: Each fix starts from a clean tree
notes.body: fixing refuses while there are uncommitted changes, so every fix is its own commit and can be undone alone. Found in the walkthrough when two fixes ended up in one commit.

notes.title: Bot protection is 'couldn't tell', never 'fail'
notes.body: Vercel/Cloudflare challenges are recognised by header or page; checks that saw them answer uncertain, a challenged home page stops the scan, and Launch Check never tries to get past a challenge.

notes.title: Hebrew spelling flags only strong signals
notes.body: Words spelled differently from a word the site repeats, and doubled letters. Prefix and ו/י variants are never flagged: the dictionary misses too many valid forms.
